也可以用点号标签重放同一个 P 2c 结构，核对换了字段名之后，哪些计算量保持原: You can also replay the same P 2c structure with dotted tags and check which calculated quantities stay the same.
1. 在 [CIF 设置练习](../#structure?cif-settin: 1. In the [CIF setting exercise](../#structure?cif-setting=practice), choose “Load the P 2c CIF.” Keep the input wavevector `(0,0,1/4)` and run the conversion. Record the input Hall setting, expanded atom count and BC wavevector, or download the complete JSON.
2. 点「载入点号 P 2c CIF」，保持波矢和容差相同，再手动转换。两份 C: 2. Choose “Load the dotted P 2c CIF,” keep the wavevector and tolerances fixed, and run the conversion again. Both inputs share the cell, sites and Hall symbol. Legacy names such as `_cell_length_a`, `_space_group_name_Hall` and `_atom_site_fract_x` become `_cell.length_a`, `_space_group.name_Hall` and `_atom_site.fract_x`. Expect zero differences in the lattice, fractional positions and BC wavevector. Both runs pass the same structure validation checks.
两次均识别空间群 4。展开采用输入 Hall 记录 7 `P 2c`，得到 4: Both runs identify space group 4, expand to four atoms using input Hall record 7 `P 2c`, and report standardized Hall record 6 `P 2yb` with BC wavevector `(0,0,−1/4)`. In the complete JSON, compare `source_tags` and `source_site_rows` under `input_metadata`. The metadata records data names in lowercase and retains their input punctuation. The source card computes SHA-256 from the original text, so the two inputs have different digests.
在点号版本的 `loop_` 前再加一行 `_cell_length_a 3`: To test duplicate detection, add `_cell_length_a 3` on a new line before `loop_` in the dotted input. It declares the same data item as `_cell.length_a 3` even though their values agree. Remove the duplicate line to run the conversion again.
